summary: Amer Sports, Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing presents IFRS-based results, including segment data for Technical Apparel, Outdoor Performance, and Ball & Racquet Sports. The report does not describe any acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, management change, or other special-situation transaction. It is a routine periodic earnings disclosure by a foreign private issuer. No deal terms, board recommendations, or unusual corporate actions are mentioned. The filing is purely operational and financial in nature.
